compile.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$env:UNITY_EXE = 'D:\Unity\UnityClient\2022.3.18f1\Editor\Unity.exe'
if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:UNITY_EXE)) { throw 'Fixed Unity executable missing' }
$unityProcesses = @(Get-Process -Name Unity -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
if($unityProcesses.Count -ne 0) { $unityProcesses | Select-Object Id,Path,MainWindowTitle | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; throw 'Unity already running; do not launch or kill it' }
$scope = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'docs/system-design/2026-09-17/demo-010-scope.json' | ConvertFrom-Json
foreach($f in $scope.validationBefore.files) { if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $f.sha256) { throw "Frozen validation input changed: $($f.path)" } }
$started = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
$compileProcess = Start-Process -FilePath $env:UNITY_EXE -ArgumentList @('-batchmode','-nographics','-quit','-projectPath','D:\Unity\UnityProj\FightMatch','-logFile','D:\Unity\UnityProj\FightMatch\Logs\FMDemoB07Compile.log') -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
[ordered]@{kind='compile';event='started';pid=$compileProcess.Id;startedAtUtc=$started;noUnityBefore=$true;sourceFileCount=$scope.validationBefore.fileCount;sourceCanonicalSha256=$scope.validationBefore.canonicalSha256;frozenFourCanonicalSha256=$scope.codeFreeze.canonicalSha256} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
$compileProcess.WaitForExit()
$compileProcess.Refresh()
[ordered]@{kind='compile';event='completed';pid=$compileProcess.Id;startedAtUtc=$started;completedAtUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');exitCode=$compileProcess.ExitCode;logPath='Logs/FMDemoB07Compile.log';logSha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath 'Logs/FMDemoB07Compile.log' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
